info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Weather Alerts Currents-v5-spec
info.description: The Current Weather Alerts API provides real-time updates on severe weather conditions impacting specific regions. Designed for developers building applications that require timely weather notifications, this endpoint allows users to access critical alert information regarding current weather events. Common use cases include integration with mobile weather apps, emergency response systems, and automated safety notifications. By retrieving these alerts, users can stay informed and make necessary preparations for inclement weather scenarios.
